Students Struggle to Access Mental Health Services

The social stigma against those with mental health struggles is declining. Students who deal with their respective mental health disability/variance will no longer tolerate suffering in silence, and they are speaking out to demand services and assistance that will allow them to succeed in their academic endeavors. For a long time here in Berkeley, mental health was the social issue that was constantly avoided, out of stigma and shame. While issues or race and economic status are common protest themes, mental health has been the one issue people were reticent to rally around. However things are now changing.
